title: Grade 4 Science — Tue, Jun 02
description: Animals & Their Habitats — Day 2 of 5: Adaptations on land
subject: science

questions.question: A special feature that helps an animal live in its habitat is called a/an:
questions.explanation: An adaptation is a special body feature or habit that helps an animal survive in its habitat.

questions.question: A camel can store fat in its hump to survive in the desert where there is little:
questions.explanation: The camel's hump stores fat, helping it survive when food and water are scarce.

questions.question: A polar bear has thick fur mainly to:
options: Keep its body warm in the cold
questions.explanation: Thick fur keeps the polar bear warm in its very cold habitat.

questions.question: A camel has long legs and wide feet to walk easily on:
questions.explanation: Wide feet stop the camel from sinking, and long legs keep its body away from the hot sand.

questions.question: A monkey has a long tail and strong arms that help it to:
questions.explanation: Monkeys are adapted to climb and swing among trees in the forest.

questions.question: The green colour of a grasshopper helps it to:
options: Hide among green leaves and grass
questions.explanation: Its green colour helps the grasshopper blend in and hide from enemies — this is called camouflage.

questions.question: Animals hiding by matching the colour of their surroundings is called:
questions.explanation: Camouflage is when an animal's colour or pattern helps it blend with its surroundings.

questions.question: A deer has long, strong legs mainly to:
options: Run fast and escape from enemies
questions.explanation: Long, strong legs help a deer run fast to escape predators.

questions.question: Why does a desert animal often rest in the daytime and come out at night?
options: To avoid the very hot daytime sun
It cannot see in the day
questions.explanation: Many desert animals stay hidden during the hot day and become active in the cooler night.

questions.question: A rabbit's long ears help it to:
options: Hear enemies and danger from far away
questions.explanation: Long ears help the rabbit hear approaching danger so it can quickly hide.

questions.question: Thick fur and a layer of fat under the skin are adaptations for living in a ____ habitat.
questions.explanation: Thick fur and body fat keep animals warm in cold polar habitats.

questions.question: A lion's sharp claws and teeth are adaptations that help it to:
questions.explanation: Sharp claws and teeth help a lion catch and eat other animals.

questions.question: Which feature helps a bird to fly easily?
questions.explanation: Birds have light bodies and feathers, which make flying easier.

questions.question: A chameleon changing its skin colour to match a leaf is an example of:
questions.explanation: Changing colour to match the surroundings is a form of camouflage.

questions.question: Adaptations are useful to animals because they help the animals to:
questions.explanation: Adaptations help animals find food, stay safe and survive in their habitat.
